title: Boruto Just Revealed an Epic New Duo Rivaling Naruto and Sasuke
content:
Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 confirms the franchise’s new duo, and they might be more compatible than Naruto and Sasuke. Although Naruto and Sasuke are equally strong and have been teammates for a long time, their compatibility has always been one of their biggest issues. With different ambitions and fighting styles, they never truly complemented each other’s powers, despite being brothers from distant bloodlines. In fact, across hundreds of episodes, there have only been a handful of instances where they fought together and truly emerged as a duo. Rather, their dynamic has always been that of rivals.

The fight against Momoshiki in the Boruto series was when fans finally got to witness their incredible teamwork. By this point, the two shared the same goals, which is why their dynamic in this fight and later against Isshiki was so exciting to witness. However, with them gone, the question of who would replace them remained. Without any surprises, the series has introduced another Uzumaki and Uchiha duo . Boruto and Sarada’s dynamic wasn’t clear at the beginning, but the latter admitting her feelings for Boruto and both of them showcasing their resolve to protect each other have shaped them into an epic duo, something the latest chapter of the series highlights perfectly.

Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 Establishes Boruto and Sarada as an Epic New Duo

Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 continues to explore Sarada’s predicament after being kidnapped by Code and Boruto’s arrival to rescue her. The titular protagonist overpowers Code and is ready to leave with Sarada immediately. However, Sarada insists that they have the perfect opportunity to take down Code. Boruto agrees, and the duo comes up with a plan to subdue him. Sarada and Boruto trick Code into thinking that Boruto has folded under pressure. However, Sarada uses her Mangekyo Sharingan ability, Ohirume, to apply gravitational pressure and subdue Code, while Boruto plants both feet on the ground and once again hits Code with Rasengan Uzuhiko, completely defeating him.

This sequence not only highlights the trust Sarada and Boruto have in each other but also shows how well their attacks complement each other. Upon closer examination, both Ohirume and Uzuhiko have elements related to gravity, and the way they use these abilities against Code highlights how even powerful enemies like him wouldn’t stand a chance against this deadly combination. However, the main element that arguably makes Sarada and Boruto’s duo more compatible than Naruto and Sasuke is their feelings for each other. The Boruto series has been particularly adamant about highlighting the element of love and how it empowers its characters.

Sarada has already showcased this by deliberately allowing Code to kidnap her so that Boruto can execute his plan, demonstrating her trust in him and her willingness to do anything for him. This is something Naruto and Sasuke’s duo completely lacked. Whenever the two came together to fight, it wasn’t because they cared about each other, especially in Sasuke’s case, but rather because of a mutual understanding of their goals. As the prominent Uchiha and Uzumaki of the Naruto sequel, Boruto and Sarada’s duo was always going to be highlighted at some point, and the series has now confirmed it through their trust, love, and complementary abilities, which could even help them surpass the iconic duo of Naruto and Sasuke.

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Webtoon Returns With Season 2 on November 24
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Korean webtoon and web novel production company REDICE STUDIO announced on November 20 the Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint webtoon will return for its second season on November 24 at 10:00 p.m. KST (8:00 a.m. EST).

The announcement included a new promotional video for the upcoming season, accompanied by the tagline, "This story is our record of survival." The second season will be released under the REDICE STUDIO and STUDIO 3B2S credits.

The webtoon launched in May 2020, and Season 1 concluded on June 9, 2026.

Author singNsong , artist Sleepy-C , and adaptor UMI 's webtoon is available in English on WEBTOON under the title Omniscient Reader .

Yen Press ' Ize Press imprint is releasing the webtoon in print under the title Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint , and released the 12th volume on October 20.

The webtoon is based on singNsong 's web novel. Ize Press began releasing the novel series in print in July 2025, and will release the fifth volume on November 24.

The series boasts a combined 2.5 billion views across the original web novel and webtoon.

Crunchyroll announced in July 2024 that the webtoon is getting a television anime adaptation.

Omniscient Reader: The Prophecy , the live-action film adaptation of the franchise, opened in South Korea in July 2025.

Com2uS is developing a game for the franchise that is slated to debut in 2028.
author: ANN

title: Tamon's B-Side Anime Gets 2nd Season
content:
Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

High schooler UtaGe! Kinoshita works part-time as a housekeeper so she can afford her fangirl obsession with Tamon Fukuhara, her favorite member of boy band F/ACE. When work serendipitously sends her to the home of her idol, she discovers that the real Tamon couldn't be more different from his wild and sexy onstage persona! Tamon is an insecure mess in real life, and what's worse, he's threatening to quit! UtaGe! refuses to let anyone stand in Tamon's way—least of all himself. What's a fangirl to do but roll up her sleeves and support her favorite singer with everything she's got?

The anime premiered on January 1. Crunchyroll streamed the first season as it aired in Japan.

Chika Nagaoka ( Uta no Prince Sama Maji Love Kingdom , Utano☆Princesama Maji LOVE ST☆RISH Tours ) directed the first season at J.C. Staff . Chiaki Nagai ( Utano☆Princesama Legend Star , The IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls ) both wrote and oversaw the series scripts. Yōko Itō ( Delico's Nursery , Love Stage!! , Skate-Leading Stars ) was the character designer and chief animation director. Shochiku , King Records , and Hakusensha produced the anime.

Shiwasu ( Takane & Hana ) debuted the manga in Hakusensha 's Hana to Yume magazine in October 2021. The series is based on Shiwasu's earlier one-shot manga of the same name.

The manga was nominated for Best Shōjo Manga in Kodansha 's 47th annual Manga Awards in 2023. The manga ranked at #9 on the top 20 on its list of manga for female readers in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.
author: ANN

title: Doraemon Anime's 1-Hour New Year's Special to Feature New Tool
content:
The official website for the Doraemon franchise announced on Friday the anime will again get a one-hour New Year's Eve special, which this year will air on December 31 at 8:00 a.m. JST.

The new special will focus on adapting for the first time the "secret tool memo" by Fujiko F. Fujio , which is currently being displayed at an art exhibition commemorating the 15th anniversary of the Fujiko F. Fujio Museum in Kawasaki city in Kanagawa prefecture. The "secret" tool being used will be the "Entrance and Exit Chalk," which, when used to draw a door, can transport someone to someplace else in the world that has that same door design.

The special will also have two other segments: the previous episode "Obaa-chan no Omoide" (Grandma's Memories) and the episode "Märchen Land Nyūjōken" (Admission Ticket to Märchen Land).

Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Jōki Jikansha (Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Steam Time Locomotive), the 2027 Doraemon film , will open in Japan on March 5, 2027.

The 2026 Doraemon film , Eiga Doraemon: Shin Nobita no Kaitei Kiganjō ( Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil ), opened in Japan on February 27.

title: 'Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!?' Second Season in Production
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yuki Shiwasu 's Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? ( Tamon's B-Side ) manga announced a second season on Saturday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured).

Produced by J.C.Staff , the anime aired for 13 episodes in Winter 2026. Crunchyroll streamed the series with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.

Shiwasu originally published the idol-themed romantic comedy manga as a one-shot in Hana to Yume magazine in August 2021, before beginning its regular serialization in the magazine on October 20 of the same year. Hakusensha published the 17th volume on October 20.

Uzu Natsugumo began a spin-off manga titled Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? F/ACE Off Stage! in The Hana to Yume Numa magazine in July 2025. The first volume went on sale on March 19. Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? has a cumulative 3.5 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in February 2023 and released the 12th volume on November 3. The 13th volume is scheduled for a February 2, 2027 release.

MyAnimeList also held a profile badge event for the series, where participants could collect screenshots from the anime to complete one of five available bingo cards and receive one profile badge of their choice. Entries had to be submitted through the event's official club forum topic by April 15.

title: 'May I Ask for One Final Thing?' Novel Series Ends in 8th Volume
content:
Novel illustrator Satsuki revealed on Thursday that Nana Ōtori 's May I Ask for One Final Thing? ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai Shite mo Yoroshii Deshō ka ) novel series will end with the eighth volume, which will ship on December 1 (Amazon lists the digital release for November 27). Satsuki also revealed the cover illustration they drew for the final volume.

AlphaPolis has been releasing the original web novel digitally and in print. The company released the seventh volume in December 2025.

AlphaPolis is releasing Illustrator Sora Hoonoki 's manga adaptation in English and it describes the story:

In the middle of a ball, Scarlet's fiancé, Kyle, suddenly calls off their engagement. She's falsely accused of being a bully and people unfairly call her a "Villainess." The aristocrats and noble families all denounce her. For years, she had to put up with his abuse and idiocy, but she can't take anymore of it! At her wit's end, she asks for one last favor; to give him a good fist in the face. So begins Scarlet's story of revenge against Kyle and his cronies! A fantasy about an elegant yet rebellious fighter, who doesn't let anyone take advantage of her!!

AlphaPolis has been publishing the manga in English digitally, and started releasing the manga in print in June.

The manga launched in Japan on the AlphaPolis website in June 2019. AlphaPolis released the manga's 11th compiled book volume digitally in Japan in November 2025, and in print in December 2025. AlphaPolis published two side-story volumes for the manga in March and June 2025.

The manga adaptation inspired a television anime that debuted in October 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, and CIS. The service is also streaming an English dub.

title: 'Please Put Them On, Takamine-san' Manga Ends in January
content:
The December issue of Gangan Joker published a new chapter on Friday, but Square Enix will not publish a new chapter in the January 2027 issue in December.

Hiiragi ( Kakegurui Midari ) launched the manga in Gangan Joker in January 2019. Square Enix published the manga's 11th volume on February 20.

Yen Press is releasing the manga in English, and describes the story:

Takane Takamine is the goddess of her high school. With perfect grades, athletic prowess, and unrivaled beauty, this student council president is the apple of everyone's eye-including Koushi Shirota, a below-average student with no friends or social prospects whatsoever. But he'll soon find out the secret behind Takamine's unbelievable success-her underwear! When she strips, she can undo any of her past actions, and now that Koushi knows, Takamine won't let him off so easy...

Yen Press published the manga's 10th volume in English on February 24.

The manga's television anime adaptation debuted in April 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired.
